newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arab ministers formally approve boycott resolution.
newsitem.headline: Arab ministers formally approve boycott resolution.

text.p: Arab foreign ministers formally approved on Monday a resolution recommending an end to normal relations with Israel and restoring the economic boycott.

Arab League Secretary General Esmat Abdel-Meguid read out the resolution after the foreign ministers ended two day of talks dominated by Israel's attitude to Middle East peace. "The Arab League recommended this and this is binding. All members are obliged to stick to the resolution," he added.
Arab anger with Israel came to a head when bulldozers broke ground at a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem on March 18.
Syrian Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara said:"Netanyahu's policies have forced Arab countries to take such a decision. Arabs have taken a wise decision in response to a clumsy and stupid policy."
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu accused Arab states of ganging up on Israel but called the notion that they could revive the Arab boycott "absurd".
